programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Space Tourism"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli explores the next great travel destination: Outer Space.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "The Astronauts"
programme.desc: One hundred kilometres above the Earth’s surface lies an invisible frontier: the edge of space. This is the Karman Line, the boundary between our planet’s atmosphere and what lies beyond. What does it take to cross that line?

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Getting There"
programme.desc: Launching payloads into space is a very difficult task, historically rocket launches are the proverbial 'swords into ploughshares' Missiles designed to carry atomic warheads now send satellites and probes into the solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Orbit"
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Shore to Shore"
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA on Mars.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Mars"
programme.desc: Beneath the red dust, CGI peels away Martian volcanoes and ice to reveal a once-Earth-like world and the challenges of future human missions.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: By stripping away the Sun's boiling plasma layers, this CGI study reveals the nuclear core that fuels our world while tracking lethal solar storms.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Rockets & Propulsion"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli examines how rockets are made, how they blast off, and how they make their way through the Earth’s atmosphere.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Satellites"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli delves into the world of satellites.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "The All-Powerful Sun"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli meets with a team of scientists to discuss the dynamic, explosive, and dangerous center of the Solar System: the Sun.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Arming Space Force"
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore all the ways in which wars in space might be fought and who stands to make a pretty penny developing space-age weaponry.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Above The Law"
programme.desc: Who decides the law in space? And how will it be enforced?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Caravans/Tuning Forks/Ice Resurfacer/Festival of Lights"
programme.desc: How do they build a caravan that’s tougher than an SUV? How do they forge tuning forks to provide musicians with perfect pitch? How do they resurface an ice rink in minutes? How do they put on the world’s biggest festival of lights?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Vinyl Records/Bumper Cars/Tiger Balm"
programme.desc: How do they make the world’s grooviest music, the vinyl LP? How do they build the world’s most crashed car, the dodgem? How do they create one of the world’s oldest pain remedies, tiger balm?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Alcohol Free Beer/Tomcars/Escalators/Lie Detectors"
programme.desc: How do they brew a beer that won’t make you drunk? How do they build a car that flies over rocks and boulders? How do they bolt together an escalator that will carry millions every year? How do they bust criminals with a lie detector?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Axes/Messenger Bags/Fast Rescue Boats"
programme.desc: How do they forge one of the greatest inventions of all time, the axe? How do they cut, sew, stitch and glue together a courier’s messenger bag? How do they build the world’s fastest lifeboats?

programme.desc: How do they do Wallace and Gromit’s cheese of choice, Wensleydale? How do they turn pig hair into paintbrushes? How do they distill aromatic oils from the koala’s favourite food, eucalyptus? How do they make the plastic that keeps your food fresh?

programme.title: How Do They Do It S13 - "Tesla/Horse Hair Fabrics/Pool Cleaners"
programme.desc: How do they build the world’s fastest electric car? How do they turn horses’ tails into fine fabrics? How do they clean the world’s largest swimming pools?

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Iberian Lynx: Saving the World's Most Endangered Cat"
programme.desc: The Iberian Lynx, classified as the world's most endangered cat, was once close to total extinction. Now, a group of scientists and conservationists are battling to repopulate the species, giving hope that these elusive animals may one day comeback.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Prodrive"

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Tractors"

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Vespa"
programme.desc: In this episode of Ultimate Processes Francesca Chiorando goes inside the Vespa factory in Italy - to see how they build their iconic scooters.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1 - "Waterford"

programme.title: More Curious? S1 - "Chopsticks, Coffee and Coins"

programme.title: Angry Planet S1 - "Volcanic Wedding"
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage!

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Schapbo"

programme.desc: Can you really fire a GE Minigun handheld with ammunition held in a backpack (also seen on Captain America: Winter Soldier). Additionally, for one of our larger tests – can you actually chop down a jungle forest with a minigun?

programme.desc: Using a unique method to crack a safe, Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) uses a blowtorch to cut through a safe, fill it with water, and blow the door off using a small explosive device.

programme.title: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Secrets Of Angkor Wat"

programme.title: The Animal Communicator
